tasks.CountDigits: Count the number of digits in the file name.
tasks.ReturnResult: Based on the results of previous tasks, return 'Yes' or 'No'.
tasks.ValidateDigits: Check if there are more than three digits in the file name.
tasks.ValidateDotPosition: Ensure that the file name contains exactly one dot and it is not at the beginning or end of the string.
tasks.ValidateFileExtension: Check if the extension part of the file name matches one of the allowed extensions: ['txt', 'exe', 'dll'].
tasks.ValidateFileNameStartsWithLetter: Verify that the substring before the dot starts with a letter from the Latin alphabet.
